name: MEDICAL SYSTEM NETWORK Co.,Ltd.
summary: Medical System Network Co., Ltd., headquartered in Sapporo, Japan, and formed in 1999, provides healthcare industry services. Its core business is distributing pharmaceutical products to customers that include drug wholesalers, pharmacies, hospitals and clinics. It operates through several segments, including a Community Pharmacy Network division, and also offers nursing care and advisory counseling for the medical treatment sector.
